items.text: 有个学生，把练习册的答案一字不落，全背了下来。练习册上的题，他次次满分；可一到考试，题目稍微换个样子，他就不会了。人工智能也会犯一模一样的毛病，它叫过拟合，英文是 overfitting。

Imagine a student who memorizes every answer in the workbook. He aces every practice test, but the moment the exam changes a question even slightly, he is lost. AI models can make exactly the same mistake. It is called overfitting.
